shot.projectile: easeOutQuad path from muzzle to impact; 160-250ms; random wobble max 8px
shot.collision: main splat then 3-10 secondary droplets; circles expand and flatten in 200-400ms
shot.reveal: avatar circular mask reveal 250-400ms; then nickname 200ms
shot.settle: glow fade to 0 in 250-700ms; persistent mural remains

grenade.windup: hand pulls grenade into camera view 150-220ms
grenade.flight: parabolic with spin; 400-650ms; no physical explosive effects
grenade.impact: color-cloud not damage; 250-450ms outward paint droplets
grenade.reveal: sprite FX and graffiti shape fill-in 350-700ms
grenade.camera: light shake only for tiers 4+, max 8px; accessibility option 0px
grenade.wall: do not modify geometry or perspective

canSpray.subDrops: spawn droplets along curve, not at random after finishing
canSpray.reveal: avatar mask and username appear when arc 80-100% complete

highTier: screen-wide rays must stay confined to wall/art layer, do not permanently cover LIVE UI or other people. Final full-wall art stays for configured hold period.
